subject.task: Publish one pinned semantic fact and project it into machine + human views.

machine_reading.claims: Static intake produced 1 DECLARED fact (fn.repeat) and 4 DERIVED facts. A separate execution witness is required before any contract can be called verified.

human_reading.account: The author wrote "count is a nonnegative safe integer" above repeat(). Running the code shows the function accepts -1 and 2.5 without complaint, and 2.5 emits three values. The comment describes an intention, not a guarantee.

comparison.agreement: Both views agree on identity, signature, source lines and publication digest.
comparison.discrepancy: The DECLARED precondition is contradicted by OBSERVED behavior.
comparison.independence_note: The witness is this process executing the fixture. It is a first-party observation, NOT independent referee proof and NOT a general correctness claim.

feedback.teaches: A semantic publication must carry an evidence class per fact, or a human wiki will inevitably render an unenforced doc comment as a guarantee.
feedback.challenges: The assumption that static compilation alone can produce an accurate human view.
feedback.smallest_next_test: Replay this exact comparison with a second, independent implementation of the intake step and check whether both derive the same DECLARED set.
